board.conclusion: Our research suggests that water scarcity encouraged farmers and engineers to experiment, cooperate and develop solutions that could be used beyond Israel. We would also need independent evidence to measure the impact.

cards.title: Farming with scarce water
cards.detail: Parts of Israel have low rainfall. Farmers needed practical ways to use limited water.

cards.title: Precision irrigation
cards.detail: Netafim began in 1965 and developed methods to supply water more directly to crops.

cards.title: Farmers and agronomists
cards.detail: Netafim describes itself as being founded by farmers and innovators who understood the farming problem.

cards.title: Growing more with less
cards.detail: Precision irrigation is designed to help farmers grow crops while managing water use. Claims about savings should be checked.

cards.title: A problem can spark an idea
cards.detail: Practical needs, cooperation and experimentation may help explain the development of useful innovations.
